selection_law: six ordered source pairs whose P+2Q relation holds at fixed prime 47 and whose auxiliary local gates have at least one constructed centered CRT curve; the finite-field relation bit is an analysis selector, not a public-target algorithm
shift_law: for each of 600 ordered base candidate rows, let p be its collision prime and L=77*p; enumerate t in {-1,0,1}^3 lexicographic and set k_i=k_base_i+L*t_i, including t=(0,0,0)
curve_law: a1,a2,a3=47*k_i; solve exact two-point incidence for a4,a6; require nonsingularity, exact point incidence, the base local coefficient reductions at 7 and 11, and the fixed model at 47
checks: record every candidate and exact P+2Q rational relation, coefficient height, source/base hashes, status, caps and ordered row digests; independently replay all rows and positive certificates
decision: report the complete bounded 27-representative census if uncensored; otherwise preserve observed rows and leave the full rate unknown
claim_boundary: target-independent coefficient-height existence test on six preselected reduced-relation pairs, with no algorithmic single-target performance inference
